_doc: Single home for project-specific values consumed by the portable agentic layer. Reuse in another project = copy the portable tree (agents/core, agents/_shared, docs/agent-rules, docs/harness, the self-improvement framework + generic scripts) and rewrite THIS file. See docs/PORTABILITY.md. Prose in AGENTS.md / docs/agent-rules points here for parameterized facts; scripts source scripts/dev/project-config.sh.

required_contexts: Mobile — POSIX core compile gate (Linux clang)

coverage._doc: Numeric line-coverage gate (coverage.yml). threshold = blocking floor; excluded = paths carved out of the measured surface (UI is bucket-E/screenshot-tested, not ctest-testable). Graduated advisory->blocking 2026-06-04; first real measurement 67%, floor set at 65 with a raise-to-70 ramp. Ramp COMPLETE 2026-07-14: backend-impl HTTP-fixture tests (JiraUserAndMeta/JiraIssueSearch/JiraIssueMutation) lifted the measured rate to 71%, floor raised 65->70 (categories/test.md; roadmap PR-14). See docs/plans/shipped/coverage-threshold-graduation.md.

visual_validation._doc: Globs over TRACKED source whose edit warrants visual verification (Pillar 4). The localization strings live in the C++ string table SmatchetLocalization.cpp (+ its headers), NOT in a tracked Locales/*.json — those are user-supplied runtime override files placed next to the exe and are never committed (README § localization). The earlier `**/Locales/*.json` glob matched zero tracked files; a zero-match glob is dead config. test-config-globs.sh asserts every glob here matches >=1 tracked file.

environments._doc: Declared per-environment capability tiers (AGENTIC_INFRA_AUDIT.md finding C3 / Proposal P5). `scripts/dev/doctor.sh --tier <name>` (or env SMATCHET_DOCTOR_TIER) reports a required toolchain check whose tool is ABSENT and not in that tier's `expects` list as an informational `[n/a]` skip instead of a RED `[FAIL]` — so an agent knows what it genuinely cannot self-validate in this environment rather than discovering it mid-loop, feeding the cannot-validate -> escalate invariant (AI_POLICY.md § Escalate). Check ids match doctor.sh's toolchain checks: cmake ninja git compiler link.exe python. Omitting --tier keeps the legacy every-check-required behaviour (default_tier).

windows-dev.description: Full Windows dev box — the whole build + test + lint matrix is runnable.

linux-container.description: Remote Linux container (Claude Code on the web). No MSVC toolchain and no bats/gh/doctest rig; the self-validatable surface is lint + doc gates + posix-core-check + TSan + fuzzers. cannot-validate -> escalate.

ci-windows.description: GitHub Actions windows runner — full MSVC build + test matrix.

ci-ubuntu.description: GitHub Actions ubuntu runner — Linux clang lanes (posix-core-check, sanitizers, mobile NDK).

agents._doc: size_*: line budgets for agent_size_audit.py (reduce-agent-prompt-bloat Slice 0). size_budget/warn = agent-prompt class (agents/core, agents/project); contract_* = AGENTS.md; sink_warn = soft-warn-only sinks (docs/agent-rules, agents/_shared/skills). Hard caps BLOCK (delta-gated + grandfathered); sinks never block. KEEP IN SYNC with the agent_size_audit.py constants (its --selftest asserts equality).

review-panel._doc: Review-panel roster (docs/agent-rules/review-panels.md § Roster) — the shared default for WHICH models the panel runs and HOW each harness selects one. Read by agents/scripts/core/run-review.sh, which invokes each harness once per model and names the output file itself, so no skill carries a roster. flag = the harness CLI's model-selection flag; tag = the short name used in <prefix>review-<round>-<harness>-<tag>.md; id = the value passed to <flag> (the harness's real model id); start_dwell_secs = startup stagger between same-harness legs (cursor rewrites its cli-config write-temp-then-rename at startup, so concurrent starts die with EPERM — 25s clears it; others default 3). The Whip-Process original had opencode free/go tiers; here the models list is flat (the paid Go tier) — edit this list to change tiers.

governance._doc: Human-authority charter defaults (AI_POLICY.md). loop_mode / auto_merge are the committed operator defaults, read at SessionStart by agents/scripts/core/clear-session-context.sh when the matching env var (SMATCHET_LOOP_MODE / SMATCHET_AUTOMERGE) is unset; the env var overrides per session. loop_mode 'on' = action-biased human-on-the-loop, 'in' = plan-gated human-in-the-loop. auto_merge 'on' is a STANDING, revocable grant: the orchestrator auto-merges a PR once the full merge-gates poll passes (safe-merge.sh) WITHOUT the per-PR post-ship merge prompt — the gates still bind; only the asking is removed (set 2026-06-23: solo maintainer, low review availability). session_token_ceiling (tokens; input+output summed per row of the token-tracking JSONL, cache fields excluded; 0 disables) is the ADVISORY per-session delegated-subagent spend ceiling checked at SessionStart by agents/scripts/core/cost-ceiling-nudge.sh -> cost-ceiling-check.py; on a hit it prints an ESCALATE banner (never blocks — WARN-first ramp) per AI_POLICY.md § Cost control. Default 5000000 sized from observed heavy fleet sessions (the 2026-06 audit fleet died at ~4.1M tokens); tune or disable deliberately.
